decision: Keep scoped review lessons in this phase evidence; no new global memory entry needed
rationale: The existing memory-c266-recovery-closure and MEM-009 already cover truthful pending-state reconciliation and exact evidence reuse. The adapter review directly enforces the adopted P24 contract; it adds no language or verification-policy authority.
supported_observation: Passing control methods still required independent inspection of their exact assertions; the reviewer required stage/rule identity, concrete link/parent traces and path-specific mismatch evidence before acceptance.
limits: Specific to this P25 test adapter; not a claim that previous product qualification was invalid.
